newsitem.title: UK: Text of Buba's Jochimsen interest rate comments.
newsitem.headline: Text of Buba's Jochimsen interest rate comments.

text.p: Following is the text of comments by Bundesbank council member Reimut Jochimsen, when asked by journalists in London if he saw room for a further cut in German interest rates. He was speaking English.

"What does room mean? I don't think that with such an improvement of economic conditions and considering the fact that we have reached a historical low in terms of short term rates as well as long term rates...I don't see the need."

"There is agreement that it is up now to government policy to clear the way for growth. This is both fiscal reform, tax reform, pension reform -- it's a huge agenda for German politics. I think monetary monetary policy has done its job, but you never can tell. Never say never."
